subject: general
question: Who among the following served the shortest tenure as the Prime Minister of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chandra Shekhar.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chandra Shekhar **served as the **Prime Minister of India **for a brief period of **7 months** from **November 1990 to June 1991.**
 
• Chandra Shekhar was a prominent Indian politician who served as the **8th Prime Minister of India.**
 
• He was a member of the Indian National Congress party before he formed his own political party, the **Janata Dal, in 1988.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **HD Deva Gowda** served as the Prime Minister of India from **June 1996 to April 1997** for a duration of **10 months.**

 
 
• He was the **11th **Prime Minister of India and belonged to the Janata Dal party.
 
 
 
• **VP Singh** served as the Prime Minister of India from **December 1989 to November 1990** for a duration of 11 months.
 
 
• He was the** 7th** Prime Minister of India and belonged to the Janata Dal party.
 
 
 
• **IK Gujral** served as the Prime Minister of India from **April 1997 to March 1998** for a duration of 11 months.
 
 
• He was the** 12th** Prime Minister of India and belonged to the Janata Dal party.
